title: To Harriet Poole?

My dear [Miss Poole](/person/1187)[^2]
I suspected that you would have to change to Monday. I wonder if the enclosed will make any further change.

We shall be very glad to have you here on Sunday, and the carriage with [Miss Mackenzie](/person/930) in it will meet you at Bpstoke at the same time.
I suppose - as you do not say so - [Miss Dyson](/person/464) has heard no more from Heaths Court[^3]

yours affectionately

C M Yonge


[^1]: Endorsed in pencil ‘Aug. 1873/ authoress’.
[^2]: Presumed to be addressed to Harriet Poole, governess and sister of the Gosling Alice Poole.
[^3]: Heath\'s Court was the home of Sir [John Taylor Coleridge](/person/344).
